text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day. Invited by Manhattan 
Cafe, I arrived at the empty classroom she 
was using.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, right now, before your very 
eyes... lies a package of chocolate."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Can you see it?

No matter how you looked, there was no 
such thing. When I answered honestly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If you can't see something, does that 
mean... it doesn't exist?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that a little strange? After all... 
you can't even see my "friend," can you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And yet, you believe they 'exist'...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Even though invisible chocolate doesn't 
exist, an invisible "friend" does...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What is... the difference between these 
two?

Now that it's been pointed out, it makes 
sense, and I think it over. Presumably, 
the difference between the two is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Did you... understand?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Something I believe exists... So that's 
why you believe?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is that... so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Because you're that kind of person... I...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um... this is...

Manhattan Cafe took out a package of real 
chocolate.
Still, it wasn't handed over so easily—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, right now, there is a box of 
chocolates right before your eyes."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Can you see it?

A mischievous impulse suddenly struck me. 
I wondered what would happen if I said the 
exact opposite of what I actually thought.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I do have one. A proper one. A handmade 
one...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Please don't fool around... I worked 
really hard to make this...

I made her a little mad. It was an 
expression she rarely showed me. Maybe 
this counts as a Valentine's present in 
its own way.

Manhattan Cafe's questions continued 
further—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Do you think... there's enough feeling put 
into it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Please answer... using your imagination.

"...Knowing the mysterious Manhattan Cafe, 
I have a feeling it won't be filled with 
pure sentiments."
choice_data_list: I am not cooped up inside.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...It is infused. Truly. Even if you 
cannot see it, it exists..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Because that's what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Now then... for the final question.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Once you take this, there's no turning 
back. Even so... will you accept it?

I'm torn on what to do... Just as I 
thought that—
(BAM!)

I was shoved from behind by an intense 
force, as if shouting, "Go get 'em!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...-san...?
An escape route... might not even exist.
